apiVersion: harness.evopilot.io/v3
kind: HarnessProfile
metadata:
  id: api-gateway
  version: 2.3.0
  name: API Gateway Harness
  description: Domain baseline for API gateway products.
  lifecycle: published
  owner: migrated-v2
  labels:
    migratedFrom: api-gateway-harness
spec:
  classification:
    domain: api-gateway
    role: api-gateway-engineering
    taskClass: domain-task
  boundary:
    inScope:
      - Engineering work supported by the api-gateway-harness v2 contract.
    outOfScope:
      - gateway timeout from downstream api
      - api client wrapper
      - http client
      - Capabilities not supported by source evidence or declared validators.
  match:
    positiveConcepts:
      - api-gateway
      - executable-engineering
      - gateway-product
      - ingress-controller
      - traffic-proxy
      - route-matching
      - upstream-selection
      - rate-limit
      - auth-policy
      - plugin-lifecycle
      - filter-chain
      - service-mesh-gateway
      - envoy
      - kong
      - apisix
      - signal
      - api
    negativeConcepts:
      - gateway-timeout-from-downstream-api
      - api-client-wrapper
      - http-client
    requiredEvidenceKinds:
      - source-code
      - build-manifest
  components:
    - id: engineering-validation
      version: 1.0.0
      required: true
  acceptance:
    requiredEvidence:
      - target-evidence-package
      - phase-package
      - goal-completion-report
      - route-table
      - policy-matrix
      - plugin-report
      - load-summary
    blockingValidators:
      - approved-command-only
      - validation-exit-code
  evaluationPackRef: api-gateway@2.3.0

apiVersion: harness.evopilot.io/v3
kind: HarnessComponent
metadata:
  id: engineering-validation
  version: 1.0.0
  name: Engineering Validation
  description: Reusable constrained build, test, evidence collection, and validation capability.
  lifecycle: published
  owner: evopilot-harness
  labels:
    scope: product-neutral
spec:
  capability: engineering-validation
  environment:
    workspaceMode: isolated
    requiredTools: [shell, source-control]
  actions:
    - id: discover-project-commands
      description: Discover repository-declared build and test commands without executing untrusted code.
      executor: agent
      inputs: [source-snapshot]
      outputs: [command-inventory]
      timeoutSeconds: 300
      network: denied
    - id: run-approved-validation
      description: Execute only administrator-approved validation commands in an isolated workspace.
      executor: shell
      inputs: [approved-command-inventory]
      outputs: [validation-command-log, validation-result]
      timeoutSeconds: 3600
      network: restricted
  constraints:
    - Never execute source-provided commands before explicit approval.
    - Never expose credentials in command output or evidence.
    - Release claims require real command evidence.
  evidence: [source-snapshot, command-inventory, validation-command-log, validation-result]
  validators:
    - id: approved-command-only
      type: content
      assertion: Every executed command is present in approved-command-inventory.
      evidenceRefs: [approved-command-inventory, validation-command-log]
      blocking: true
    - id: validation-exit-code
      type: exit-code
      assertion: Required validation commands exit successfully.
      evidenceRefs: [validation-result]
      blocking: true
provenance:
  sourceDigests: []
  ontologyVersion: software-engineering@1.0.0
  policyVersion: default-matcher@1.0.0

metadata.name: Engineering Validation
metadata.description: Reusable constrained build, test, evidence collection, and validation capability.

actions.description: Discover repository-declared build and test commands without executing untrusted code.
Execute only administrator-approved validation commands in an isolated workspace.

constraints: Never execute source-provided commands before explicit approval.
Never expose credentials in command output or evidence.
Release claims require real command evidence.

validators.assertion: Every executed command is present in approved-command-inventory.
